notes.title: Hello Inner Worlds fans - Try our new game!
notes.content: [p]Hello Inner Worlds fans![/p][p]We'd like to invite you to try out our new game.[/p][p]Yes, that's right, we release a new game like clockwork - every 30 years or so.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out "Wrecker II: The Wreckening"[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3606010/Wrecker_II_The_Wreckening/?beta=0"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]
